FINAL IVX IA SENIOR CHAT ↔ AUTONOMOUS WORKER SYNC
EXECUTE END TO END — DO NOT ONLY EXPLAIN

OBJECTIVE

Connect IVX IA Senior Chat directly to the real autonomous senior-developer execution system.

After this task, when the owner submits a build, fix, audit, deploy, recovery, QA, database, mobile, backend, infrastructure, or production request inside IVX IA Chat, the request must create a real autonomous job and must not fall back to a narrative-only response.

==================================================
1. VERIFY THE CURRENT ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Audit and document the real current execution path:

IVX IA Chat
→ Intent Router
→ Developer Executor
→ Autonomous Job Queue
→ Worker
→ Tools
→ GitHub
→ Supabase
→ Render / EAS / AWS
→ QA
→ Production Verification
→ Chat Progress Report

Inspect at minimum:

- ivx-chat-intent-router.ts
- ivx-owner-ai.ts
- developer-executor
- autonomous worker routes
- job queue
- job persistence
- task status API
- worker polling
- execution logs
- owner authorization
- deployment authorization
- mobile and web chat clients

Confirm the actual files and routes. Do not rely on old documentation.

==================================================
2. CONNECT CHAT TO THE AUTONOMOUS WORKER
==================================================

When the router identifies any of these intents:

- developer_executor
- self_developer_execution
- build
- fix
- audit
- deploy
- QA
- recovery
- database repair
- owner-login repair
- API repair
- mobile repair
- production verification

IVX IA Chat must create a real worker job.

Required behavior:

POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs

Request body must include:

{
  "goal": "<complete owner prompt>",
  "source": "ivx_ia_chat",
  "requestedBy": "<authenticated owner id>",
  "conversationId": "<chat conversation id>",
  "messageId": "<chat message id>",
  "priority": "critical | high | normal",
  "executionMode": "autonomous",
  "requiresProductionProof": true,
  "requiresOwnerApprovalForDangerousActions": true
}

Return:

{
  "taskId": "<real persistent task id>",
  "status": "queued",
  "createdAt": "<timestamp>",
  "statusUrl": "/api/ivx/ia/<taskId>",
  "streamUrl": "<live progress endpoint if supported>"
}

The chat must show the real task ID immediately.

==================================================
3. REMOVE THE NARRATIVE-ONLY FALLBACK
==================================================

For senior-developer tasks, do not send the request to the legacy chat-brain path after classification.

Remove or block this behavior:

Developer request
→ log decision
→ generate explanation
→ return narrative
→ no job created

Replace it with:

Developer request
→ authenticate owner
→ validate intent
→ create persistent job
→ worker claims job
→ execute
→ stream progress
→ return verified result

A narrative response is allowed only when:

- the user is asking a question rather than requesting execution;
- execution is impossible and the exact technical blocker is proven;
- owner approval is required for a dangerous action;
- a credential returns a verified missing, expired, revoked, 401, or 403 error.

==================================================
4. OWNER AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Only the authenticated IVX owner may create autonomous senior-developer jobs.

Verify:

- owner session
- owner role
- JWT/session validation
- authorization middleware
- conversation ownership
- task ownership
- access to task logs
- access to production controls

Non-owner users must receive HTTP 403.

Never expose:

- secrets
- API keys
- tokens
- environment variables
- private logs
- financial records

==================================================
5. JOB PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Every autonomous job must be stored in production data.

Create or verify tables such as:

ivx_autonomous_jobs
ivx_autonomous_job_events
ivx_autonomous_job_steps
ivx_autonomous_job_artifacts
ivx_autonomous_job_approvals
ivx_autonomous_job_logs

Each job must store:

- task ID
- owner ID
- conversation ID
- source message ID
- original prompt
- normalized goal
- intent
- priority
- status
- current phase
- progress percentage
- created time
- started time
- last heartbeat
- completed time
- worker ID
- retry count
- error code
- final result
- commit SHA
- deployment ID
- build ID
- production URLs
- proof artifacts

Jobs must survive:

- application restart
- Render restart
- mobile restart
- browser refresh
- chat navigation
- temporary network failure

==================================================
6. JOB STATUS LIFECYCLE
==================================================

Use a real state machine:

RECEIVED
→ AUTHORIZED
→ QUEUED
→ CLAIMED
→ PLANNING
→ EXECUTING
→ TESTING
→ QA
→ AWAITING_OWNER_APPROVAL when required
→ DEPLOYING
→ VERIFYING_PRODUCTION
→ VERIFIED
→ COMPLETED

Failure states:

BLOCKED
FAILED
CANCELLED
TIMED_OUT
ROLLED_BACK

Do not mark COMPLETED unless production evidence exists.

==================================================
7. LIVE CHAT PROGRESS
==================================================

IVX IA Chat must display live status from the real autonomous job.

Show:

- task ID
- current phase
- progress percentage
- active step
- files being inspected
- tools being used
- tests running
- blockers
- retries
- commit created
- deployment started
- production verification
- final result

Use one of:

- Supabase Realtime
- Server-Sent Events
- WebSocket
- controlled polling

The chat must not invent progress.

All displayed progress must come from stored job events.

==================================================
8. CHAT COMMANDS
==================================================

Support these owner commands:

- status
- continue
- pause
- resume
- cancel
- retry
- approve deploy
- reject deploy
- show logs
- show proof
- show blockers
- rollback
- open task
- list active tasks

Each command must act on a real task ID.

==================================================
9. AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION CAPABILITIES
==================================================

Verify the worker can actually execute approved tools for:

- repository inspection
- file editing
- code generation
- unit tests
- integration tests
- API tests
- database queries
- Supabase migrations
- RLS audits
- Expo / React Native checks
- EAS builds
- Render deployments
- GitHub commits and pushes
- AWS verification
- health checks
- production smoke tests
- regression tests
- rollback

Do not claim a capability unless a real tool binding exists and passes a live test.

==================================================
10. CREDENTIAL RULE
==================================================

Assume IVX credentials already exist in stored production variables.

Do not ask the owner to provide credentials again by default.

First verify:

- variable exists
- runtime can load it
- binding name is correct
- correct environment is using it
- service can authenticate
- API response

Only request new access when runtime evidence proves:

- missing variable
- expired credential
- revoked credential
- deleted credential
- HTTP 401
- HTTP 403

Return the exact service, variable name, endpoint, status code, and error.

==================================================
11. OWNER APPROVAL GATES
==================================================

The worker may automatically:

- inspect code
- create a plan
- edit non-production files
- run tests
- perform QA
- analyze logs
- prepare migrations
- create commits
- prepare builds

Require explicit owner approval before:

- destructive database migrations
- deleting production data
- changing payment settings
- changing banking information
- changing DNS
- rotating credentials
- production deployment when configured as owner-gated
- irreversible infrastructure changes
- rollback with possible data loss

The chat must present a clear Approve or Reject action.

==================================================
12. CONCURRENCY AND DUPLICATION CONTROL
==================================================

Prevent:

- duplicate jobs from one message
- repeated POST requests
- two workers executing the same task
- duplicate deployments
- duplicate commits
- duplicate database migrations

Use:

- idempotency key
- source message ID
- job locking
- worker lease
- heartbeat
- atomic claim
- retry protection

One chat message must create exactly one autonomous job.

==================================================
13. FAILURE RECOVERY
==================================================

Implement:

- worker heartbeat
- stale-job detection
- retry policy
- maximum retry count
- resumable steps
- checkpoint persistence
- timeout handling
- failed deployment rollback
- owner notification
- exact error reporting

A worker restart must resume from the last safe checkpoint rather than starting blindly from zero.

==================================================
14. COMPLETE END-TO-END TEST
==================================================

After implementation, run this real production test from IVX IA Chat:

TEST PROMPT:

"Audit the IVX health endpoint, verify the live GitHub commit, run the backend smoke tests, and return verified evidence. Do not deploy."

Required proof:

1. Chat request received.
2. Intent classified as developer execution.
3. Real autonomous job created.
4. Persistent task ID returned.
5. Worker claims the task.
6. Progress appears in chat.
7. Worker runs the health check.
8. Worker verifies the GitHub commit.
9. Worker runs the smoke tests.
10. Worker stores logs and artifacts.
11. Chat displays the final verified result.
12. Refresh the page and confirm the task remains visible.
13. Restart the service and confirm the task history remains visible.
14. Confirm no duplicate task was created.

Then run a controlled deployment test on a harmless change:

- change a production-visible version marker;
- run tests;
- create a commit;
- push the commit;
- deploy;
- call /health;
- confirm live commit equals GitHub HEAD;
- display proof in IVX IA Chat.

==================================================
15. MOBILE AND WEB PARITY
==================================================

Verify the same autonomous task behavior on:

- Android native build
- Expo development build if still supported
- iOS
- web
- chat.ivxholding.com

Verify:

- task creation
- live status
- reconnect
- task history
- approval actions
- logs
- final evidence
- no keyboard overlap
- no duplicate messages
- stable message and task IDs

==================================================
16. AUTONOMOUS DASHBOARD SYNC
==================================================

Every job created from IVX IA Chat must appear immediately in the Autonomous Dashboard.

Display:

- task ID
- task name
- originating conversation
- assigned AI/worker
- status
- phase
- progress
- runtime
- retries
- outcome
- commit
- deployment
- proof
- owner approval status

Every dashboard task must also be openable from IVX IA Chat.

Chat and dashboard must read from the same production job records.

==================================================
17. EXECUTIVE LAYER SYNC
==================================================

Only real completed autonomous actions may increase:

- Runs
- Loops
- Outcomes
- Completed Work
- Product Health
- Daily Activity

Do not count:

- chat narratives
- simulated actions
- planned actions
- proposals
- repeated UI requests
- failed attempts without an execution record

Every displayed autonomous count must map to real job IDs.

==================================================
18. REQUIRED PRODUCTION EVIDENCE
==================================================

Return all of the following:

- exact root cause
- architecture before fix
- architecture after fix
- files changed
- line ranges changed
- database migration details
- API endpoint test
- request and sanitized response
- real task ID
- job event records
- worker logs
- screenshots from chat
- screenshots from autonomous dashboard
- GitHub repository
- branch
- commit SHA
- Render deployment ID
- EAS build ID when mobile code changes
- /health HTTP 200 response
- live production commit
- GitHub HEAD
- proof both commits match
- Android result
- iOS result
- web result
- verification timestamps

==================================================
19. FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
==================================================

Mark this task VERIFIED only when all are true:

[ ] IVX IA Chat correctly classifies senior-developer requests.
[ ] One chat message creates exactly one persistent autonomous job.
[ ] The worker receives and claims the job.
[ ] The worker executes real tools.
[ ] Progress is shown live in chat.
[ ] The same job appears in the Autonomous Dashboard.
[ ] Refresh and restart do not lose the task.
[ ] Owner commands control the task.
[ ] Dangerous operations require owner approval.
[ ] Final results contain real logs and evidence.
[ ] Narrative-only fallback is removed for execution requests.
[ ] Executive autonomous metrics use real job records only.
[ ] Android, iOS, and web are verified.
[ ] Production deployment is verified.
[ ] GitHub HEAD equals the live production commit.

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

Return:

OVERALL STATUS:
PASS / FAIL

ROOT CAUSE:
Exact technical cause

SYNC STATUS:
Chat → Router
Router → Job API
Job API → Queue
Queue → Worker
Worker → Tools
Worker → GitHub
Worker → Deployment
Worker → QA
Worker → Chat
Worker → Autonomous Dashboard
Worker → Executive Layer

TEST TASK ID:
Real task ID

PRODUCTION PROOF:
Repository:
Branch:
Commit SHA:
Deployment ID:
Build ID:
Health status:
Live commit:
GitHub HEAD:
Commit match:
Verification time:

Do not answer with promises, plans, percentages, or narrative claims without execution evidence.

The final result must prove that IVX IA Senior Chat is now the real owner-controlled interface for the autonomous senior-developer system end to end.
